verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's official docs explicitly cover installing NVIDIA drivers and building custom NVIDIA kernel modules via DKMS, directly matching the story. However, coverage is NVIDIA-specific (no explicit mention of AMD/Intel GPU driver workflows) and a dated community comment notes friction with proprietary driver blobs on Nvidia hardware. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of successful DKMS module builds, and documentation for non-NVIDIA GPU vendors.
